answer: Every identity runs on a vertex, a host with a fuse burned once and never reused, so one host backs only one identity and no host can be rented in bulk. A sparrow carries each fuse to the mint and signs its arrival, so a fleet needs a fleet of sparrows. The mint counts the fuses already burned on an operator's chain: the next vertex there costs that many zephyr, forfeited if that identity is judged fake. An honest newcomer posts one zephyr; a thousand identities on one chain post five hundred thousand. A fresh chain means abandoning the old one, burning everything posted.
